wage_hourly.part_time_hint: Part-time staff have a higher hourly minimum wage.

payroll_config.title: Payroll settings
payroll_config.description: Pay rules and pay groups for your payroll runs.

policy.title: Pay rules
policy.defaults_note: Using the standard Labour Act rules. Change them here if your organization pays differently.
policy.custom_note: These rules apply to every new or recalculated payroll run.
policy.ot_multiplier_hint: Times the regular hourly rate. The Labour Act minimum is 1.5×.
policy.half_day_fraction_hint: Share of a day paid for a half day, e.g. 0.5.
policy.festival_amount_hint: Full-year amount; prorated for workers employed less than 12 months.
policy.festival_month_hint: New runs for this month include the festival allowance by default.
policy.weekly_off_paid_hint: Monthly staff are paid for the weekly day off.
policy.admin_only: Only the owner or an admin can change pay rules.

groups.title: Pay groups
groups.description: Pay some workers in their own monthly run — by site, wage type or contractor.
groups.dialog_description: Workers who match every selected filter belong to this group.
groups.name: Name
groups.criteria_hint: Leave a section empty to match everyone for it. A worker belongs to the oldest active group that matches.
groups.pay_day_hint: BS day of the month (1–32). For your reference.
groups.active_hint: Inactive groups get no new members; their workers go to the main run.
groups.members: {count, plural, =0 {No active workers} one {# active worker} other {# active workers}}
groups.empty_body: Everyone is paid in one monthly run. Add a group to pay some workers separately.
groups.rule_note: Workers not in any group are paid in the main run. Nobody is paid twice in the same month.
groups.delete_body: {name} will be removed. Groups that already have payroll runs can only be deactivated.

run_dialog.group_none: Main run (everyone not in a group)
run_dialog.group_hint: Each pay group has its own run for the month.

ops_flags.title: Feature flags
ops_flags.subtitle: Turn features on or off without a deploy. Every change is audited.
ops_flags.dialog_description: A flag overrides the matching server setting while it exists.
ops_flags.empty_body: Server settings decide every feature. Override one below or create a new flag.
ops_flags.defaults_body: Current values from the server configuration.
ops_flags.enabled_hint: Off means off for everyone, whatever the rollout.
ops_flags.percent_hint: 0–100. Each organization always lands in the same bucket.
ops_flags.client_visible_hint: Sent to signed-in users through GET /flags. Leave off for server-only switches.
ops_flags.delete_body: {key} will be removed and the server setting applies again.
